title: Fixed-current Hilbert material-stress audit
question: Does metric variation of the Nulloth material action at fixed densitized currents reproduce the written Carter stress when coherence and every scalar-material coupling are nonzero?
prediction: The finite metric variation agrees with the analytic material stress to a maximum component error no greater than 2e-8 for the symmetric branch and two nonzero coherence amplitudes.
falsifier: Any compared metric component differs above 2e-8 or a nonzero-coherence case cannot be evaluated without adding a separate interaction stress.
controls: The zero-coherence case recovers the previously audited Theory 3.3 variation.
Positive and negative coherence amplitudes test the even scalar-material interaction independently of sign.
Densitized baryon and carrier currents are held fixed during metric variation, matching the pullback-current convention.
seed_rationale: The currents, entropy, amplitudes, and centered metric variations are deterministic.
